verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The round-2 approval remains supported. The detector preserves fail-closed polarity across missing scanner, shallow or unreadable history, unresolved ref, scanner self-test failure, scan failure, unreadable alert state, and delivery failure. The workflow remains manual-only while the required scanner is absent, and its parsed-YAML seam tests non-vacuously couple future scheduling to scanner presence, pin full-history checkout and exact call-site arguments, and retain least-privilege permissions and SHA-pinned actions. End-to-end tests exercise clean, exposed, unverified, dedupe, recovery, routing, malformed payload, and public-sink behavior; structural checks constrain mutation authority and prevent stderr publication. No new correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security defect is supported by the diff.
